knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假想 1 mW 輸入，兩輸出為 0.46、0.44 mW，總傳輸 0.90，過量損耗 −10log10(0.90)=0.458 dB；不平衡 10log10(0.46/0.44)=0.193 dB。理想均分每路 3.010 dB 是功率分配，不是 3.010 dB 的過量損耗。 自成像近似只提供初估，需以足夠模態、正確端口和波長掃描驗證；數值收斂與實物校準是不同工作。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical 1 mW input and 0.46/0.44 mW outputs, total transmission is 0.90, excess loss 0.458 dB and imbalance 0.193 dB. The ideal 3.010 dB per branch is power division, not excess loss. Self-imaging approximations give initial estimates; verify sufficient modes, correct ports and wavelength sweeps. Numerical convergence differs from physical calibration.

options: 功率看起來平滑就表示模態數足夠
細網格可以補救錯誤對稱設定
增加模態數直到功率和相位均穩定，而非只看一條曲線。
optionsEn: Smooth power curves prove sufficient modes
Fine mesh compensates incorrect symmetry
Increase mode count until both power and phase stabilize.

quiz.explanationEn: Increase mode count until both power and phase stabilize. Self-imaging approximations give initial estimates; verify sufficient modes, correct ports and wavelength sweeps. Numerical convergence differs from physical calibration.
